description.text: Stadium Challenges were large tournaments of Pokémon Organized Play's first season. In 2004 they were held in Europe in May and June and at three venues in the United States in July, and every player got Metang with a Stadium Challenge stamp. The next season replaced them with Regional Championships, and the last Stadium Challenge was a single event in Salzburg, Austria, in June 2005, whose players got EX Deoxys' Deoxys with its own Stadium Challenge stamp until supplies ran out.
